A hall built for gathering

CMR Function Hall sits on Kudali Road in Pallegudem, a village in Khammam district, and serves as one of the area's spaces for weddings, receptions and community events.

The hall keeps its doors open around the clock, so families arranging early-morning muhurtams or late functions can plan around the occasion rather than the venue's hours.

It's rated 4.2 out of 5 by 116 people who've attended or hosted functions here — details below.

శుభకార్యం

What the space is for

As a function-hall facility, the venue is set up to host the full range of occasions families in Pallegudem and around Khammam gather for.

Weddings & receptions

Ceremonies, receptions and the events around them, for families organising the full wedding sequence in one place.

Engagements

Betrothal and engagement functions, sized for extended family and close community.

Birthdays & anniversaries

Milestone celebrations that call for a hall rather than a home — first birthdays, shashtipoorthi, anniversaries.

Community & religious functions

Gatherings that bring the wider village and community together under one roof.
